desc: Read input N, Q, A, and queries.
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials modulo 998244353.
Compute $S_1(x)$ for all $x$ using FFT (convolution of $A$ and $H$).
For each query $(u, v)$, compute $T(u,v) = \sum_{k=2}^u A_k H_{v-k+1}$ efficiently.
Compute final answer using formula and print.
